task: Backtracking toolkit: unique multiset permutations, N-Queens, combination sum
reasoning_summary: Wrote 15 tests first, then three recursive backtracking routines sharing a choose/recurse/undo shape. Duplicates are skipped by sorting and the used[i-1] rule; N-Queens uses column and two diagonal boolean arrays; combination sum uses a long remainder. All 22 test cases passed on the first run.
